blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Abner Hizarsa was on his way to his daughter’s school in Subic, Zambales, to bring her lunch when he was abducted by unidentified armed men in a van without a license plate on March 21, 2007. Until today, his common-law wife, Cresencia dela Cruz, and his three children have yet to find out where Hizarsa was taken. “All the places where we could find him… nearby hospitals in case someone wounded or dead was brought there, we asked for him. Up to here, in Manila. In Camp [Tolentino] in Bataan, Camp Aguinaldo, Camp Crame. We searched all of those places,” […]...
